tools.name: wordpress-fleet_site-inventory-normalize
tools.description: Copy supplied sites, plugins, and themes into a consistent inventory. Counts come from the request only. No site is logged into. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/site-inventory-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_plugin-version-audit
tools.description: Compare installed plugin versions with caller-supplied or WordPress.org public releases. An older version is a version-age warning. A vulnerability is listed only when the caller supplied it. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/plugin-version-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_theme-version-audit
tools.description: Compare installed theme versions with caller-supplied or WordPress.org public releases. An older version is a version-age warning, not a confirmed vulnerability. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/theme-version-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check
tools.description: Compare a site's stated WordPress and PHP versions with public requires and tested fields. A match is not treated as proof that an update is safe. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/update-compatibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_plugin-conflict-detect
tools.description: Flag duplicate active plugin slugs and caller-supplied conflict pairs. A match is not a confirmed runtime conflict. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/plugin-conflict-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_site-maintenance-priority
tools.description: Rank supplied sites by outdated software, caller-supplied vulnerability matches, compatibility gaps, and conflict flags. The ranking does not approve an update. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/site-maintenance-priority. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_risk-analyze
tools.description: Summarize version-age warnings and caller-supplied vulnerability matches across the inventory. Version age is not treated as a confirmed vulnerability. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/risk-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: wordpress-fleet_agency-report
tools.description: Combine the inventory, version audits, compatibility metadata, conflict flags, and maintenance priorities. The report does not log into sites or install updates. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/wordpress-fleet/agency-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "wordpress-fleet" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check · Public sink: wordpress-fleet_site-inventory-normalize, wordpress-fleet_plugin-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_theme-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check, wordpress-fleet_plugin-conflict-detect, wordpress-fleet_site-maintenance-priority, wordpress-fleet_risk-analyze, wordpress-fleet_agency-report · Destructive: wordpress-fleet_site-inventory-normalize, wordpress-fleet_plugin-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_theme-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check, wordpress-fleet_plugin-conflict-detect, wordpress-fleet_site-maintenance-priority, wordpress-fleet_risk-analyze, wordpress-fleet_agency-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check · Public sink: wordpress-fleet_site-inventory-normalize, wordpress-fleet_plugin-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_theme-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check, wordpress-fleet_plugin-conflict-detect, wordpress-fleet_site-maintenance-priority, wordpress-fleet_risk-analyze, wordpress-fleet_agency-report · Destructive: wordpress-fleet_site-inventory-normalize, wordpress-fleet_plugin-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_theme-version-audit, wordpress-fleet_update-compatibility-check, wordpress-fleet_plugin-conflict-detect, wordpress-fleet_site-maintenance-priority, wordpress-fleet_risk-analyze, wordpress-fleet_agency-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
